change: One execution-order collector for transfer/convolution/turbulence/filter brushes; borrow transfer tables, retain generated lattices and move brush records directly to upload. No compatibility collectors remain.
timing_scope: NativeRenderer::render through submission and wait. Submit stops when the renderer returns its receipt; complete includes GPU completion. SVG parsing, context/renderer initialization, final readback and PNG output are excluded.

separate_process_protocol.interactive_qos: For named interactive series only, a temporary dylib sets main-thread QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE before main. No production scheduling change.

modes: compare: committed baseline versus final implementation
control: two renderers using the final implementation
paired_protocol.order: Each cycle renders both variants, waits for each completion and alternates which variant runs first. Process modes also alternate launch order.
paired_protocol.baseline_package: An isolated committed snapshot renamed tileink_before so both versions link into one process; dependencies are pinned by the copied lockfile.
paired_protocol.native_shader_inputs: All 40 shader recipes are identical between linked versions; compiled artifact hashes differ between compilation roots. The current worktree active shader manifests are byte-identical to the original baseline.

raw_samples.compression: gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSON; every earlier series, control, individual frame and PNG hash is retained.

interpretation: Separate-process series vary substantially, including worse results for the cleanup and large changes when the identical executable is compared with itself. Longer sampling and interactive QoS alone do not remove that variation. Same-process, alternating-frame comparison keeps complete-frame median changes between -1.10% and +0.52%; same-implementation controls vary by up to +1.36%. CPU submission medians change between -1.10% and -0.13%. These four measured applications preserve performance within observed control variation. Latency tails remain variable: the image-brush same-implementation control changes complete-frame p95 by +31.58%, so tail changes are not attributed to cleanup. No universal GPU or frame-throughput speedup is claimed.
limits: Actual DXC/ShaderTools and DX12/Vulkan GPU execution unavailable.
The same two missing-DXC failures and preexisting scaled-turbulence canonical-image failure remain.
The paired baseline package rename changes link layout; these measurements do not establish universal workloads or other-backend performance.
temporary_artifacts: Temporary Rust examples, paired application, isolated baseline source, copied executables, QoS code/library and measurement PNGs removed after validation; raw measurements retained in the compressed archive.
